raw:
@q query
  where all
    match
      relation "publish"
      role subject "Dr. O'Neill-Haddad"
      role object ?x
      role time ?t
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "be about"
      role subject ?x
      role object "C. difficile"
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
  at "last year"
